scope: Source and observation review for the next P1 decision. No human data fitted and no quantitative biological acceptance bounds invented.

candidates.measuredEndpoint: Human muscle AS160 phosphorylation; separate Akt phosphorylation sites are also reported.
candidates.reason: The archived model has no AS160 state and one lumped Akt activation pool. Relabeling AktP as AS160 or either measured phosphorylation site is not an observation model.

candidates.evidenceInspected: Primary paper methods, results and discussion
candidates.measuredEndpoint: GLUT4/dystrophin image colocalization in human muscle after glucose ingestion and exercise.
candidates.reason: Pearson image correlation is not a surface amount or fraction. Its change cannot be used directly as a GLUT4 fold-change; nearby vesicles are unresolved by this assay. A spatial measurement model would be needed.

candidates.evidenceInspected: Primary paper methods, Figure 2 legend and results; supplement metadata via public Figshare API
candidates.measuredEndpoint: Exofacial LM048 sarcolemmal fluorescence in nonpermeabilized human muscle fibers.

sourceProtocols.preparation: in vivo human muscle, hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp

candidates.proposedObservation: Within-donor, background-corrected stimulated/basal surface fluorescence ratio compared with modeled surface GLUT4 amount ratio.
unresolved: Confirm fluorescence response and background normalization before equating ratios.
Separate sarcolemmal from total model surface GLUT4, including T-tubule contribution.
Acquire paired donor-level values or a reviewed extraction with explicit digitization error; individual fibers are not independent donors.
Match stimulus exposure and basal conditions; a maintained 100 nM source pulse is not the human clamp input.

candidates.evidenceInspected: Primary paper abstract; full methods not obtained

acceptanceDesign.primaryMetric: Log stimulated/basal response after an admitted observation mapping
requiredBeforeFitting: Record paired measurements, preparation and stimulus time course with provenance.
Specify primary endpoint and uncertainty construction using donor variability, assay error and any digitization error.
Freeze data split, parameter bounds and numeric acceptance interval before fitting.
Retain a separate test for transfer from cell preparations to human muscle.
